name: invoice-debt-app
description: نظام إدارة الفواتير والديون بالعربية (RTL) — Next.js + Tailwind + Prisma + ExcelJS

scripts.autostart:setup: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$s=(New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell).CreateShortcut('%USERPROFILE%\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\invoice-app.lnk'); $s.TargetPath='C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe'; $s.Arguments='-WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "cd /d C:\Users\DELL\Desktop\invoice-app; npm run start"'; $s.WorkingDirectory='C:\Users\DELL\Desktop\invoice-app'; $s.Save(); Write-Host 'Startup shortcut created.'"
